road_eval — DRIVE long op

• Data kinds: table × scalar → any

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.road_eval(road, l: 'float') -> 'Tuple[float, float, float]' (to call the implementation directly, import drivelong; drivelong.road_eval(road, l: 'float') -> 'Tuple[float, float, float]'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("road_eval"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

道の縦断を弧長 l で引く: (z, sin θ, cos θ)。road = None(平ら)/ 数値(一定の勾配角 θ [rad]、z = l sin θ)/ road_profile の dict。折れ点の上ではその先の区間の値(右連続)。
